cpi_first_release.score_interpretation: One CPI target only. Baseline is original September first print, not a revised later September series. No inference about calibrated skill.

nikkei_interim_market.diagnostic_warning: Not a refreshed forecast; relies on zero-drift iid Gaussian remaining returns and 2/5 trading-time scaling. Frozen hybrid/LLM interval distributions are not themselves Gaussian, so the interval-cross probabilities are a Gaussian sensitivity benchmark only. Markets can jump and volatility can cluster.

interpretation.cpi: October all-items +0.4% vs September +0.6% means a -0.2 percentage-point change. LLM and hybrid assign less than 50% probability to an increase; simple zero-change gives 50%. All monthly scores are retrospective checks against unchanged Nov7 forecasts.
interpretation.market: Nikkei already positive from Nov6 to Nov11 but Friday target unresolved. Conditionally estimated tail probabilities describe a hypothetical uncalibrated model, not a live forecast or scored test.
interpretation.hypotheses: A single positive relative score for hybrid CPI provides no evidence of durable Q001/Q003 gain; both nonreported YoY fields expose avoidable target-eligibility failure, as identified before release on Nov10.
